title: kbingest map on Windows lets cmd.exe run a node found in the worktree folder
goal: On Windows the mapper environment sets NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath=1, so an npm cmd-shim (tsc.cmd, npm.cmd) that falls back to a bare node never runs a node.exe or node.bat committed in the project folder it runs in; a test named kbingest_map_windows_no_cwd_lookup asserts scrub_env sets it when os.name is nt (and does not require it elsewhere), and a planted removal fails it (sprint review ST-ptn4bkh3 finding F3)
